headline: Golden Knights’ Mitch Marner to miss game vs. Blues for birth of child
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Mitch Marner will miss the Golden Knights' game against the Blues so he can be with his wife, Stephanie, for the birth of their second child.

It is a one-night absence, but it takes a productive piece out of a team that has been good so far this season. Marner has 12 points in 11 games, 10 of them assists, and the team does better when he plays: VGK's share of expected goals, a measure of chance quality, at five-on-five is about 2.4 points higher with him on the ice. He has two goals against about three expected from his own chances, so his scoring is running a bit cool, which suggests the production is real. VGK are 8-3-0 and create 56.9 percent of the expected goals in their games, though they have outscored their chances by 4.2 goals, a margin that tends to shrink. STL are 4-4-1, and their goaltending has cost them 2.2 goals below expectation.

Going by how the coach has used his players, Mark Stone is next in line for Marner's minutes, and Braeden Bowman, the busiest man on the second power-play unit, is the likeliest to move up to the first unit.
